1.title: Newsom Signs Bills Meant to Prevent Trump’s Interference in Midterms
1.summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom of California signed legislation that would make it illegal to interfere with ballots or election records in response to efforts by the president to restrict voting.

2.title: Trump Says His Son Will Pay Back Russian Businessman for Wedding Party
2.summary: The president said his eldest son, Donald Trump Jr., had decided to return the money, but defended the gift worth hundreds of thousands of dollars as “totally allowed.”

3.title: Vikki Goodwin Accuses Dan Patrick of Violating Texas Deepfake Law
3.summary: The complaint raises new questions about how a state law applies to the growing use of A.I.-generated attack ads.

4.title: Russia Warns New U.S. Sanctions Law Would Harm Trump’s Peace Efforts
4.summary: President Trump signed the legislation, named for Senator Lindsey Graham, at the White House, but he has broad leeway to waive its requirements.

5.title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi capital after smoke seen rising near Riyadh airport
5.summary: The King Khalid International Airport incident caused hours of flight disruptions and comes amid an escalating conflict with Houthi rebels in Yemen.

6.title: Journalists denied White House access after Trump banned some media outlets
6.summary: CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters' White House press badges were confiscated, the outlets reported.
